decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, portable Bluetooth speaker suitable for outdoor activities. My consideration set includes well-known brands like JBL and Altec Lansing, as well as highly-rated budget alternatives. I filtered out several product entries that were actually accessories (cables, cases, handles). The JBL Clip 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_002) is a strong contender but is listed as a renewed product. The Altec Lansing (prod_bluetooth_speakers_045) is a classic choice, but the INSMY speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) offers superior specifications for the price, specifically its 20W output and 24-hour battery life, which are significantly higher than other compact models in this price bracket. Based on the positive reviews regarding its durability and sound level, it is the best value for my needs.
